submission.justification: Among all tested absorber materials and plate thicknesses, Absorber-F1 with a plate thickness of 5 mm provides the best energy resolution at 100 GeV (3.264%). This choice satisfies all project constraints: F1 is a listed candidate material, 5 mm is within the allowed 2-10 mm range, and the plate design allows for hands-on maintenance. No other material or thickness combination achieves a lower (better) energy resolution in the provided simulation results.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F1 at 5 mm gives the lowest recorded energy resolution (3.264%) among all candidates and thicknesses.

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F1 is one of the tested materials, matching the specified candidates.

requirements.requirement: The calorimeter must allow hands-on maintenance during shutdowns.
requirements.evidence: 5 mm absorber plates are compatible with hands-on maintenance, based on project documents and standard practices.
Selected plate thickness is 5 mm, within the specified range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended material and plate thickness.
requirements.evidence: A single combination is recommended: Absorber-F1 at 5 mm thickness.
